notes: Created from the 2026-10-19 HuggingFace discovery crawl. Benchmarks are the card's own published rows (vendor claims). architecture and task are inferred from the slug and param ratio; KV geometry, context length and quant sizes are not yet filled, hence status draft. KV basis: 40 layers x 8 KV heads x 64 head_dim x 2 (K and V) x 2 B = 81,920 B/token (80.0 KiB). head_dim is absent from config.json: derived as hidden_size 2560 / 40 attention heads = 64, which is also the value that reproduces the published 3.40B parameters at intermediate_size 8192 (head_dim 128 would put it near 4.1B). Uniform full attention, no sliding window, no hybrid layers.
